body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Motorola introduced its Digital Cordless phone with Android 'HS1000 Series DECT 6.0' at CES.

It features digital answering machine(15 min. recording time), caller ID and picture caller ID (via SD card), 2.8" resistive touch screen with vivid colors, Wi-Fi, Abdroid 1.6 OS system, flash memory 256MB, SD-RAM 128MB.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
